en.askTitle: Swap in your own dates, hours and budget and get the same Hanoi stay check before you book anything
en.runTitle: Sydney to Hanoi: three months for a remote designer, from 1 February 2027

fields.label: Passport and freelance-work situation
fields.value: Freelance designer working remotely from Australia, single

fields.label: Monthly budget plus arrival cash
fields.value: Housing about USD 600–800 a month for a furnished studio or 1-bedroom with fast internet

fields.label: Preferred areas
fields.value: Tay Ho / West Lake, Ba Dinh, Hoan Kiem, Dong Da and Cau Giay compared

en.template: Plan a Hanoi stay for {situation} on {dates}, keeping {hours} and {budget}. Compare quiet furnished flats in {areas}, show rent, deposit, utilities and every unknown together, and check entry permission separately from paid-work permission. Build a tested internet/mobile backup and a Tết arrival plan. Separate dated samples from real quotes. Plan only; do not contact anyone, book, apply, create accounts or pay.

phases.title: Look up current listings and the practical rules for a three-month stay
phases.note: Entry permission, residence registration, clock changes and live rental pages
phases.judgment: It caught that the Tết public holiday is already settled: the government has approved 4–10 February 2027, not just proposed it. Individual business closures are left marked as unconfirmed.

phases.title: Write the guide and the source list, with estimates labelled
phases.note: Area comparison, ten listings, SIM and internet options, February air and a monthly budget
phases.judgment: It said plainly what it could not confirm: February vacancy and whether landlords accept three months. The air-quality figure is labelled as last year’s February reading, not a forecast.

phases.title: Independent check of the arithmetic, links and page layout
phases.judgment: The independent reviewer rechecked the budget range, the 89-day stay and the April clock change, and flagged that the SIM prices are data plans, not full purchase costs.

workers: Checked the official sources on air quality, mobile and internet plans, Tết dates, clock changes and coworking access
Opened six live furnished listings in Tay Ho and Ba Dinh and recorded rent, charges and deposit for each
Found four more listings in Hoan Kiem, Cau Giay and Ba Dinh to cover the central areas
Independently reviewed the finished guide: coverage, arithmetic and whether the claims match the sources
